settings.title: Sistema Tessera Sanitaria
settings.description: Reports patient healthcare expenses to the Sistema TS for the pre-filled tax return.

scope.title: Patient invoices only
scope.text: Every paid invoice to a private person is sent to the Sistema TS automatically (credit notes as refunds, voids as cancellations). Invoices to companies go through the SDI instead. A patient who opposes is still reported, without their codice fiscale.

sistema_ts.usernameHelp: The codice fiscale of the sender as registered on sistemats.it.
sistema_ts.pincodeHelp: The 10-digit code issued by the Sistema TS; encrypted before every request.
sistema_ts.certificateVendored: Using the Agenzia delle Entrate certificate shipped with the module (valid until {at}). Upload the new one when the portal regenerates it.
sistema_ts.cfProprietarioHelp: The professional's codice fiscale (or the structure owner's); sent encrypted as cfProprietario.
sistema_ts.structureHelp: Region, ASL and structure codes apply to accredited/authorised structures only; leave them empty as a professional.
sistema_ts.syncFromHelp: Leave empty to report everything paid since the beginning.

year.title: Year {year}
year.lastResponse: Last answer from the Sistema TS: {at}

itemTypes.title: Expense type per treatment
itemTypes.help: Items without a choice use the default ({default}). SR = healthcare services; IC = cosmetic (not deductible); AD = medical devices sold.

documents.title: Sistema TS submissions
documents.description: Every paid patient invoice as sent to the Sistema TS, with its protocollo.

panel.title: Sistema Tessera Sanitaria
panel.waiting: Paid patient invoice: it will be reported to the Sistema TS on the next run.

opposition.title: Sistema TS opposition
opposition.help: The patient may object to their expenses reaching the Agenzia delle Entrate. Documents are still reported, without the codice fiscale.
opposition.recorded: Opposition recorded; accepted documents will be re-sent anonymised
opposition.revoked: Opposition revoked; accepted documents will be re-sent with the codice fiscale
